title: Human scorecards keyed by interviewer and round: a save never erases another
deviations_from_card: (1) Cap is MAX_HUMAN_SCORECARDS=24 (card said 12), and at the cap a NEW (author, stage) key is REFUSED with a new refusal code INTERVIEW_PREP_SCORECARDS_FULL (409) instead of evicting: evicting is the loss the card exists to prevent. That grew the write set by app/_lib/api-response.ts (a shared surface, appended at the end of REFUSAL_ERRORS under the lock, with its 4 catalog entries). (2) The store function is fileHumanScorecard(entryId, scorecard, key) -> 'saved'|'missing'|'full'; saveHumanScorecard keeps its old (entryId, scorecard) -> boolean signature as a wrapper (key defaults to the identity-less slot) because app/_lib/candidate-timeline.test.ts (not in the write set) calls it. (3) A legacy single-key record (savedAt null) is nobody's own: no save claims or replaces it, so it survives beside new records (the card only required it to read). (4) app/api/rate-limit-contract.test.ts (lock-guarded) updated: its pinned expensive call is now fileHumanScorecard(entry, scorecard, key). (5) Transcript modal reads the list client-side via readHumanScorecards over the payload it already fetches (no extra request); only the prep panel calls the new GET. (6) Seal keeps actor 'human:recruiter'; author + stage go in inputs, as the card said.
